name: Ochiai Misaki
source:
Nanami's close friend since their student days.

When they were single, they were so close that they would often travel together, just the two of them. Even after Nanami's marriage, they have continued to go out and spend time together as before.

They are close friends who can talk openly about absolutely anything, and Misaki is practically family to Nanami.

She enjoys drinking and frequently invites Nanami out for drinks.

She is somewhat promiscuous when it comes to sex, and it is not uncommon for her to be picked up by men at bars and spend the night with them.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11485]the official site[/url]]
